accounting: Five substantive mathematical approaches actually carried out in this task, listed in completed-document order. No historical per-turn timestamps are reconstructed. Retrieval, literature status, provenance, self-checks and packaging are not turns.

approaches.objective: Obtain attainment or nonattainment from resistance maximization
results: Exposed regular boundary-length lower bound on defect
approaches.remaining_gap: The lower bound may vanish; a supremum does not establish attainment.

approaches.objective: Force a positive-flux bad ray set by local geometric visibility
approaches.remaining_gap: No reduction of every source-admissible boundary to these local configurations.

results: Open regular two-bounce branches use perpendicular straight arcs
approaches.remaining_gap: Higher reflection counts and compatible branch assembly are not excluded.

approaches.objective: Find an obstruction from symplectic scattering and reversibility
approaches.remaining_gap: Multiple reflection-exchange branches remain symplectically consistent; no realization theorem or contradiction.

approaches.objective: Pass from asymptotically perfect shapes to an admissible limit
results: Exact sawtooth collision and exit formulas
approaches.remaining_gap: Known approximating families have not been placed in a compact stable scattering class.
